newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Argentina, Paraguay dam to seek World Bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Argentina, Paraguay dam to seek World Bank loan.

text.p: Top officials from the joint Argentine-Paraguayan Yacyreta hydroelectric dam will travel to Washington to seek a $654 million loan from the World Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank, Yacyreta said Monday.

"Yacyreta's Paraguayan director, Joaquin Rodriguez, and his Argentine counterpart, Gustavo Petracchi, will work to obtain from the World Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank a loan to finance the remaining work on the hydroelectric generators," Yacyreta said in a press release.
The officials will leave for the United States this week.
The funds will go to raising the dam's level to a height of 274 feet (83 meters) above sea level from 251 feet (76 meters).
The governments of Paraguay and Argentina decided in Decmber to postpone until March a protocol to privatize Yacyreta.
